verdict.rationale: Composio is API/SDK-first (sessions, meta-tools, MCP, CLI, webhooks) with an OpenAPI spec confirming broad programmatic coverage, and the dashboard appears mainly for auxiliary config like white-labeling and connection management rather than being the primary interface. However, evidence doesn't confirm true parity — e.g. white-labeling/branding and dashboard-based auth config are UI-only per docs, and there's no explicit statement that all dashboard settings (branding, project config) are also exposed via API. missing for 10: confirmation that dashboard-only features like white-labeling/branding are configurable via API, independent verification of full UI/API parity, and hands-on confirmation beyond docs.
